inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Must Use for Each Child in When Transporting and be Properly Installed: Three of the seat belts in the new van were not in working condition; when pulling them to buckle, one would not come out as if it was jammed, and two would not tighten and were loose.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Must Use for Each Child in When Transporting and be Properly Installed (26 TAC §746.5607(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The emergancy preparedness plan did not state how the infants will evacuate the building. There is also information missing on how to care for children while waiting for the all-clear.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather: The operational handbook lacked a section on promoting indoor play during extreme weather conditions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(F))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: Five staff members were short on training hours within their annual year.   two staff members need SIDs and Safety training.  Three staff members need to complete up to 11 hours of training in Guidance and Discipline, age-appropriate curriculum, SIDS, Health and Safety, Emergency preparedness and Abuse and neglect.   One who needs to complete twnenty one hours in  Guidance and Discipline, age-appropriate curriculum, SIDS, Health and Safety, Emergency preparedness and Abuse and neglect, rick to children, and safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Additional Services Offered: The operation did not notify their child care regulation licencing inspector to let them know that they sold the old vehicle and purchased a new ten-passenger van.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Additional Services Offered (26 TAC §746.301(7))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: The newly purchased ten-passenger van that the operation has been using for the past week does not have an alarm installed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: One out of seven employees did not have an up-to-date first aid certificate available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Annual fire inspection was not available for review; the last inspection was January 22, 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: Four out of ten children files reviewed did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The gate door latch to the back playground is not functioning properly and is not latching securely.    One of the toilets is not in working condition.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: One trash can accessible to children did not have a lid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguishers have not been serviced since January 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation did not report the number of employees to leave the operation by the required date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two out of eight children records reviewed did not have current immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: The two staff did not have the required trainings at review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The operation did not have a completed playground checklist for the past month at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The yearly employee varication was not completed in the provider portal.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: In the handbook or application there was no signed verification that the parents were aware of their parent rights.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: It was observed in the infant room a bottle that was not labeled with the child's name and last initial.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The most recent fire inspection report was not available for inspection.  The last recorded inspection was held on 1.11.2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Recommended Clothing and Footing: Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity was not available to review in the operational policy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Recommended Clothing and Footing (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(E))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: The infant feeding forms was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: Six out of ten files reviewed did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Three out of the ten children files reviewed, were missing the emergency contact person's address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: In a classroom with a specified age of 1-12 months, a caregiver was alone with seven children. In another group there were 24 children ranging in age from toddler - PreK with a caregiver and a volunteer.   Noted: this was corrected during the inspection when another caregiver was brought into the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A infant child, under 12 months was observed to be laid in the crib with a blanket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: It was determined through an investigation that prohibited discipline, slapping children's wrist, was being used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: A fire extinguisher was sitting on a half wall and not mounted to a wall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §746.5305)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was in charge of five infants with a specified age group of 0 to 11 months. This was corrected at inspection when an older infant was moved to the toddler room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met: There were 4 infants under the age of 17 months that was mixed with children 18 months and older during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met (26 TAC §746.1613(a))

occurrences.finding: Special Diets - Discuss Eating Problems With Parents: A child that was enrolled in the after-school program did not want to eat breakfast or lunch that was offered to him.  This was not communicated to the parent until the following day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Special Diets - Discuss Eating Problems With Parents (26 TAC §746.3311(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The last fire inspection was conducted on 8-11-2020. Fire inspections are due annually.  The director was able to make an appointment for 2-15-2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The one out of two fire extinguishers located in the building was last serviced in August 2020.  This was corrected when the director called for the company to come out and service them during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two out of eight records were missing a health statement signed by a doctor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two out of eight children's records were missing the emergency contact of another responsible individual who should be contacted in an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: There was no transportation safety training available for review at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
